policies.title: Tajik ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa at port of entry
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Tajikistan as Port of Entry, which it defines as a visa granted on arrival.
conditions: Applies to a Tajik ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada's schedule defines Port of Entry as a visa granted on arrival.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Tajik ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Tajik visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to a Tajik ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Tajik ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule names Tajikistan in its authorized-visa cohort, requiring approval before travel.
conditions: Applies to a Tajik ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country-document waiver.
The authorized visa must be granted before travel and approval may take up to 60 business days; applicants should confirm local filing procedure with their competent Panamanian consulate.
Passport validity, residence, special documents, work, transit and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Tajik ordinary passports: Mongolia electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Mongolia's official Immigration Agency eVisa site lists Tajikistan among eligible Visa Countries and describes an electronic apply, pay and receive-visa process.
conditions: Apply using the Tajik ordinary passport; the official system requires at least 180 days' passport validity before intended travel.
Apply and pay online, then receive and carry the eVisa before travel; it is electronic issuance, not a border-issued visa.
Purpose-specific, work, residence, special-document and final-admission requirements remain outside scope.

application.label: Mongolia eVisa application
steps: Select the Tajik ordinary passport and appropriate short-visit eVisa category.
Complete the application and pay online using the official system.
Receive and carry the issued eVisa before travel.

Mongolia's official Immigration Agency lists Tajikistan among eVisa countries and its process issues the visa electronically before travel.
